quote: We believe the loss of our largest purchaser would not have a material adverse effect on our operations, as crude oil and natural gas are fungible products with well-established markets and numerous purchasers in our producing regions.
why: "fungible products"と"numerous purchasers"で原油・ガスは代替の効く商品と自ら述べる。顧客の乗り換え費用の記述なし。

quote: Our long-term leases generally require our lessees to maintain all units on lease for the duration of the lease, which provides us with scheduled lease payments.
why: "require our lessees to maintain all units"で借手に期間中の保有を義務づける複数年リース。再認定までは言わない。

quote: The Company competes with many different types of retail stores that sell many or most of the same products.
why: "sell many or most of the same products"と競合店が同じ商品を扱うと述べるだけ。顧客の乗り換え費用には触れない。

quote: The client community generally must deliver minimum quantities of municipal solid waste to the facility on a put-or-pay basis and is obligated to pay a fee for its disposal.
why: "put-or-pay basis"と"obligated to pay"で自治体顧客に最低搬入量の支払いを課す長期契約。再認定ではない。

quote: Our strong, installed base in North America also yields competitive advantages in after-market services, although this segment of the market is highly competitive and price sensitive.
why: "installed base"を強みとするが同じ文で"price sensitive"と認め、顧客側の乗り換え費用は述べていない。

quote: While providing these services requires an initial capital investment, we make these investments only after securing long-term contracts with wireless carriers, typically for a period of five years, and believe these contracts and the expected growth in wireless bandwidth needs will provide an attractive return on our capital outlay.
why: 基地局回線は"long-term contracts with wireless carriers"で"five years"の購買義務を課す。一部事業のみ。

quote: The global market for the products of our Seeds and Genomics segment is competitive, and the competition has intensified.
why: "the competition has intensified"と一般的な競争記述のみ。農家が負う乗り換え費用の機構は名指しされない。

quote: Competition for the transportation of LPG, refined petroleum products and crude oil can be intense and depends on price, location, size, age, condition and the acceptability of the vessel and its managers to the charterers.
why: "can be intense and depends on price"と価格・船齢等で傭船者が船を選ぶと述べる競争記述。乗り換え費用の機構なし。

quote: Our policy renewal rate on voluntary business (excluding assigned risk plans), which represented approximately 89% of the segment’s gross written premiums in 2012 , was 86%, 82%, and 82% in 2012 , 2011 and 2010 , respectively.
mech: 解約率・更新率の実数
why: "policy renewal rate"を"86%, 82%, and 82%"と更新率の実数で開示。ただし年次更新の保険で摩擦の機構は弱い。

quote: If a manufacturer designs another supplier's product into one of its product platforms, it is more difficult for us to achieve future design wins with that platform because changing suppliers involves significant cost, time, effort and risk on the part of that manufacturer.
why: "changing suppliers involves significant cost, time"を顧客側の負担と断定。再認定の明言はなく当社が外側。

quote: We are in direct and active competition, with respect to one or more of our product lines, with at least 10 manufacturers of such products, of varying size and financial strength.
why: "at least 10 manufacturers"と直接競合を認める一般的な競争記述。顧客の乗り換え費用は名指しされない。

quote: Most of our client project contracts, including those that are on a fixed-price and fixed-price service level agreement (“SLA”) basis can be terminated with or without cause, with zero to ninety days notice and without termination-related penalties.
why: 契約は"without termination-related penalties"で解約できると明記。顧客が負う乗り換え費用は無い。
